chunks: Abu Bakr al-Habbal from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Qattan al-Madaini said, 'I heard my father saying, 'Mas'ada ibn al-Yasa' narrated to us,'

'I said to Abu Abdullah Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him), 'By Allah, I love you!' So he bowed his head, then raised it and said, 'You have spoken the truth, O Abu Bishr! Ask your heart about what is for you in my heart regarding your love, for my heart has informed me about what is for me in your heart.'

key_terms.أَطْرَقَ: He bowed his head in thought or modesty

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq say when told he was loved?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the concept of *al-walayah* (spiritual affinity) in Shia theology, where the Imam’s heart serves as a mirror reflecting the believer’s inner state. It underscores the Shia belief in the Imam’s spiritual insight (*kashf*) and the reciprocal nature of love between the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers, reinforcing the idea that true love is recognized through internal spiritual resonance rather than mere verbal declaration.

en.hubeali:
Abu Bakr Al Habbal, from Muhammad Bin Isa, Al Qattan Al Madainy who said, 
‘I heard my father saying, ‘Mas’ada Bin Al Yas’a narrated to us saying, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, I love you<sup>asws</sup>!’. So he<sup>asws</sup> bowed, then raised his<sup>asws</sup> head, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Bishr! Ask your own heart about what is for you in my<sup>asws</sup> heart from your love, so that my<sup>asws</sup> heart would know about what is for me<sup>asws</sup> in your heart’.
en.sarwar: 3. Abu Bakr al-Habbal has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa al-Qattan al- Mada’ini who has said that I heard my father saying, ‘Mas’adah ibn al-Yasa’ who has said the following:

“Once I said to abu Ja’far (a.s.) ‘By Allah, I love you.’ Abu Ja’far (a.s.) looked down for a short while then he raised his head and said, ‘O abu Bishr you have spoken the truth. Ask your heart about what my heart has of your love. My heart has informed me about what your heart has for me.’”
